promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-03 (nyiso-117). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-03-nyiso-117-nyc-rcpf (bundle results/calibration/nyiso117_nyc_stepcurve). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat, UNCHANGED at 3/0/14. WHAT THIS PROMOTION DOES: it COMPOSES the two orthogonal rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] corrections that were split across two lanes and neither of which contains the other -- the CT heat-rate meter-artifact INPUT fix already on the incumbent keeper (caiso-160, screen f6238a5), and the NYC locational RCPF demand-curve SHAPE mechanism nyiso_nyc_rcpf_step_curve (nyiso-115). ONE config delta, ZERO free parameters: the DOF ledger goes 30 -> 31 entries with n_residual UNCHANGED at 6, because the $25/MW level is the published NYISO ASM section 6.8 Reserve Capacity Penalty Factor and the SHAPE is measured from NYISO's own posted zonal DA ancillary-service prices -- there is nothing in the mechanism to tune. THE MECHANISM WAS NOT RE-DERIVED, RE-LEVELLED OR RE-SCOPED HERE (rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE]): this is a re-solve on a corrected input, not a re-opened question. Its ex-ante evidence stands unchanged because it measures NYISO's POSTED PRICES and is therefore unaffected by any model-side CT artifact -- the locational regions nest (NYCA > East > SENY > NYC), so zone J minus a zone sharing every region EXCEPT NYC isolates the NYC-only dual; all three such references (DUNWOD/MILLWD/HUD VL) agree EXACTLY and the two non-SENY controls do not. LEVEL CONFIRMED (never exceeds $25.00 in 26,301 hours; the 10-min product stacks to exactly $50.00 in precisely the hours the 30-min sits at $25.00 -- 5/5, 16/16, 98/98). SHAPE REFUTED (a smooth continuum plus ONE ATOM at the ceiling, 17/45/141 h, and essentially no mass at the model ramp's interior rungs, 0/1/2 of 103/167/428). GATES -- ALL PASS, against a same-HEAD zero-delta control (2026-08-03-nyiso-117-control-zerodelta), which is MANDATORY rather than optional because FINDING-nyiso114 section 2 measured that a P0-run-pattern keeper does not re-solve to byte-identity once main moves. G1: the NYC families reach exactly $25.00 in 14/6/19 (10-min) and 2/6/8 (30-min) hours and sit on an interior ramp rung in ZERO hours of all three years. G2a (THE SCOPE KILL, and it is written on CONSTRUCTION): all seven non-NYC families' requirement_mw -- the balance-row RHS, the one pure INPUT in the sidecar -- are float32-EXACTLY identical to control in all three years. That specification inherits nyiso-115's lesson that its own G2 demanded byte-identity of dual and held_mw, which are SOLVED OUTPUTS of a co-optimization and so could only be identical when the mechanism did nothing; and it asserts equality as np.array_equal rather than against a 1e-6 MW tolerance the float32 dtype cannot represent (nyiso-116). G2b (an independent instrument that never touches the parquet): the solve log's ORDC step count falls 73 -> 59 in EACH of the three years, a drop of exactly 14 = 2 families x 7 lost rungs, with the family count unchanged at 9. G3 (held + shortfall >= requirement everywhere, tight exactly where the family prices), G4 (zero unserved-energy slack and zero dump in BOTH arms, all years), G5 (2023-2025 in one bundle per arm; holdout freeze ACTIVE and untouched), G6 (both arms scored, determinations identical) all PASS. K-A/K-B/K-C/K-D/K-E do not fire. ALL 18 SCORED NUMERIC FIELDS ARE EQUAL between the two arms. THE NULL WAS PRE-REGISTERED, NOT DISCOVERED: prereg section 5 stated in advance that a step and a ramp are BOTH $0 at or above the requirement, so this moves the LEVEL in hours a family already binds and CANNOT add binding hours. K-E measures it directly -- binding hours GAINED = ZERO in every family and every year (the 30-min family loses 5 hours in 2023 and 1 in 2025, a shortfall crossing zero, which the prereg also anticipated). C3c is UNCHANGED and this does NOT reach nyiso-110's everyday-reserve-formation gap and is NOT reported as closing it. THE SESSION'S OTHER RESULT, AND IT CORRECTS THE RECORD: the supersession this session was ordered to repair NEVER HAPPENED. nyiso-115's arms were ALREADY on the POST-fix CT artifact. This session's control is BIT-IDENTICAL to nyiso-115's control AND to the incumbent keeper, and its treatment is BIT-IDENTICAL to nyiso-115's treatment -- max|dMW| = 0.000000 and max|dprice| = 0.000000 on every class-hour and every zone-hour of all three years. That is NOT a claim that the CT fix is inert: caiso-160's own pre-fix vs post-fix arms differ by max|dMW| 508.19/628.89/387.23 and max|dprice| $10.50/$10.56/$9.04, so the fix moves NYISO substantially where it applies and nyiso-115 simply already had it. The artifact vintage had been ASSUMED from commit ordering rather than measured. PRECISELY: in a fresh container git merge-base --is-ancestor cannot see other branches' commits and SAYS SO (exit 128, 'fatal: Not a valid object name') -- git does distinguish that from a genuine negative (exit 1). What collapses the two is the ordinary cmd && yes || no idiom, which maps every non-zero exit to 'not an ancestor', so the shortcut is unsound AS USUALLY INVOKED -- the same failure mode as reading a pipeline's exit status instead of the process's. Compare the dispatch instead. Yielding the keeper was therefore unnecessary -- reasonable given what was known, but the record should say that nyiso-115's keeper was never stale. RELATEDLY, FINDING-nyiso114 section 2's drift caution did NOT fire between b8d5e04 and this session's HEAD: control-vs-keeper drift measured EXACTLY 0.0 on the NYC duals. The same-HEAD control was still the right design -- drift is not knowable in advance -- and its value here is precisely that it turned an assumption into a number. PROMOTION RESTS ON RULE 1 [R-STRUCT] / RULE 14 [R-ACCURATE], NOT ON GATE MOVEMENT: the published curve belongs in the model because it is the real one. (For the record, and NOT as the basis: the C3a mean-LMP magnitudes move marginally toward actuals, -0.6% -> -0.5% and -9.5% -> -9.4%; every criterion verdict, the grade summary 9 scored / 8 target / 1 ledgered / 0 fails, and the C1 headline all 14/14 free 10/10 are IDENTICAL to the incumbent's.) SEPARATELY, AND WITHOUT A SOLVE, this session screened SENY's demand curve ex ante on the same instrument and recorded S-OVER: the isolated SENY-only adder caps at $23.92/$30.37/$40.00 with 52 hours of 2025 at exactly the published $40 increment and ZERO above in any year, while the model's very first ramp rung is $62.50 -- so 9 of 10 binding hours are OVER-priced, the opposite direction to NYC. That is nyiso_ordc_measured_step_span's mechanism and is RECORDED, NOT ACTED ON (rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]); it needs its own pre-registration and its own arm. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso117-stepcurve-compose-2026-08-03.md, PREREG-nyiso117-nyc-stepcurve-compose-2026-08-03.md, _nyiso117_stepcurve_gates.json, nyiso117_seny_rcpf_curve_screen.json.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
